name: Stage 53: Sandviks badplats to Karlfors kvarn
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 53, Sandviks badplats to Karlfors kvarn.
utilities: Official area: Nyköpings kommun, Nynäs, Trosa kommun.

Sandviks badplats is the start-side beach/service node with summer tap, toilet, fireplaces, parking, and nearby Stage 52/53/53:1 connections; Sandviks camping is a separate paid service node west of the badplats.

Långmaren is the key mid-stage cultural and water node, with museum-farm context, an official waterpost behind/near the dwelling, and seasonal/event-based visitor services; exterior access is useful year-round but cafe/events, toilet access, and water function are current-check.
Karlfors kvarn/Månbacken is the end-side access node with rest shelter/old washhouse context, mill heritage, parking, and nearby line-554 bus platforms.

Intermediate parking is described at/near Klackavägen, Långmaren, the Långmarenvägen trail crossing, and the Klackavägen/Tofsövägen crossing. Treat these as small local access points where signs and overnight restrictions must be checked on site.
waterSources: Official water points are Sandviks badplats, the spring after about 3 km, and Långmaren. Treat Sandvik as seasonal/summer water, the spring as natural water to treat/filter, and Långmaren as current-check tap water.
No additional dependable all-hours potable source was verified between Långmaren and Karlfors.
Surface water and wetlands in Nynäs reserve are natural water only and should not be treated as practical drinking-water refills.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official and Naturkartan catalog distance is 11 km. Local drawn route is about 10.32 km, OSM relation 6571869 measures about 10.42 km while tagging 11 km, and Naturkartan API geometry measured about 10.15 km in the 2026-04-27 review. Keep official planning distance and measured map distance separate.

Topology: stage 53 starts at Sandviks badplats proper, with branch 53:1 beginning roughly 270 m east/southeast along the first Stage 53 segment. OSM Stage 52 and 53 snap together near Sandviks badplats, while Naturkartan appears to start Stage 53 closer to the 53:1 branch point. Stage 53 ends at Karlfors kvarn where stage 54 begins, and it is also part of Nynäs Runt.

Expect a hilly, rocky Nynäs-reserve stage rather than an easy road walk: forest, bedrock slabs, uneven climbs, meadows/pastures, the Källkälla spring, creeping spruce, older fire-scarred forest, Långmaren, Nyckelby grave field, road 219 crossing, and a final rocky descent to Karlfors. If walking Karlfors-to-Sandvik, that final descent becomes an immediate steep climb.

Recurring flooding around Långmaren is an official issue. Keep the normal route geometry, but follow current local/official alternate-route guidance and any temporary red reroute markings if the ordinary route is wet.

Livestock in pastures is possible, especially around Utängstugan and the Långmaren/open-land portions. Close gates, keep dogs controlled/leashed, give animals space, and avoid walking between cattle and calves.

Recent user-facing reports describe the trail as well marked/good condition, but the official text flags the left uphill turn after a few hundred metres from Sandvik as easy to miss. Older reports also mention high grass, soft muddy holes at Sandviks badplats, quiet/low-traffic trail days, and hunting-season signage near Karlfors; treat these as situational awareness, not fixed closures.
Sörmlandsleden is maintained and permitted as a hiking trail. Use roads or marked cycle routes for cycling/riding rather than wet, rocky, or pasture-sensitive footpath sections.

facilities.name: Current fire-ban check
facilities.description: No municipal fire ban was found for Sörmlandskustens area during the 2026-04-27 research check, but live fire-ban status can change quickly. Check same-day municipal/Krisinformation status before using any solid-fuel fire.

facilities.name: Nynäs reserve camping/fire rules
facilities.description: No tent/hammock/wind-shelter overnighting except designated places, normally max one night. Fires/grilling only at managed fireplaces with provided wood; Sandviks camping follows its own rules. Do not collect or damage living/dead wood.

facilities.name: Hiking-trail use caution
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden asks cyclists and riders to avoid the footpath because landowner permissions and trail surfaces are intended for hiking. Use existing roads or marked cycle routes instead, especially near wet ground, hällmark, and pastures.
